title: Lang Log languoid
description: One record of Lang Log (a family, language, dialect or a source-only grouping or sample), in the same shape whatever source it comes from. Every value says which source and version it came from.

id.description: Glottocode, or <source>:<id in that source> for a record that exists only in another source.

path.description: URL path below https://lang-log.github.io/, without leading or trailing slash; a historical stage ends in #<anchor>.

lang.description: Language tag of the name as the source gives it; empty when not given.

same_language.description: The name is recorded in the language itself (its tag matches the record's ISO 639-3 code).

classification.description: Parent of this record in each source that classifies it: {<source>: {parent: <Lang Log id or null>}}. The site nests records by Glottolog.

category.description: Glottolog's non-genealogical grouping the record belongs to (Sign Language, Pidgin, Bookkeeping ...), or null for spoken genealogy.

features.description: Values of Lang Log features (features/index.json), keyed by feature id. A feature without data is left out.

value.description: Lang Log value id, chosen from the evidence by source priority.

disagreement.description: Present and true when the evidence gives more than one value.

feature.description: Feature id in that source, such as WALS 81A.

raw.description: The value as the source writes it.

record.description: The source's own id of the language the value was recorded for.

sources.description: Source id -> version of every source this record has data from.
